title: NNSA defines 18 machine-readable reviewer-receipt templates
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy and National Nuclear Security Administration
summary: Every NNSA decision row now has a receipt template for reviewer identity, reason code, cited source, decision time, escalation state, and publication-review handoff. Denominator: 18 templates across 3 contracts; zero actual reviewer identities, receipts, or handoffs.
key_findings: Evidence stage: NNSA conformance, validation, and receipt controls.

Boundary: A template cannot create a reviewer identity or decision.
Boundary: Receipt fields remain empty until an actual cited packet receives human review.
Boundary: Accept still routes only to a separate publication review.
Next action: Require a complete receipt before any actual review decision can advance to publication review.
